archetypes.name: dyn-lint-escalation
archetypes.rationale: Changed lint-fix pre-dispatch escalation logic and regex detection for complexity-baseline logs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the run_lint_fix pre-dispatch ordering and complexity-baseline log detector. Check that only real metric-growth or new-identity regression rows under a complexity-baseline command fast-fail. Verify generic tool errors and unrelated lint failures still dispatch to external fixers, and no-tool complexity regressions keep ledger_exit_code=1. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
